headline: Restructuring in the auto market: decline in new vehicles, stability in used cars and the emergence of electric vehicles
summary: New vehicle registrations in Argentina are contracting by an average of 20% so far this year. Used car sales are stable and electric vehicles are emerging, amid tax changes and shifting consumer habits.
why: Vehicle sales are a barometer of consumer demand and credit conditions, and they reflect Argentina's broader economic cycle and tax policy.
